resources.string:
USB Gadget Tool gives you full control over the USB Device services on your phone. For this ConfigFS on the OS Kernel is used.

 By tejado (Tjado Mäcke)

 Website:
 https://github.com/tejado/android-usb-gadget
Click on a Gadget for more options!

Types a short test text into the connected host, so click into a text field there first. This keyboard only supports the US English layout, so it may type wrong characters if the host uses another layout.
Typed text goes to the host as you type
Keys go to the host as you type. Only letters, digits and US keyboard symbols are sent.
Typing in 3 seconds. Click into a text field on the host now.
The host read every key. Check that "%1$s" appeared.
The host read the release of all keys.
The host did not read the keys in time. Check the cable and that the host recognized the gadget.
No active gadget with a keyboard function.

Starts a temporary test authenticator. Then register and sign in on a WebAuthn test site, such as webauthn.io, on the host. It approves every request without asking and forgets its keys when stopped, so never use it on a real account.
No active gadget with a FIDO CTAP function.
Only gadgets added at boot can be activated at boot!\nSee gadget configuration below

Please test the gadgets carefully before enabling them during boot!

Adding / activating gadgets during boot can lead to infinity reboot loops on certain devices!

Gadgets are getting added / created after unlocking the screen. Before that, the system default is applied.
